objective: Evaluate whether a model can reconcile conflicting operational evidence.
constraints: Each task must be independently answerable from its supplied evidence.

dimensions.name: Evidence reconciliation
dimensions.measurement_target: Correctly reconcile records that differ in reliability and recency.
dimensions.boundary: Do not require private or unstated domain knowledge.
dimensions.approach: Construct self-contained generation tasks with auditable evidence and scoring.

content_design.description: Reconcile several operational records and explain the supported conclusion.

output_requirements.format: A concise conclusion followed by cited evidence.

requirements: The conclusion must follow the most reliable and recent evidence.
The response must identify the conflicting evidence.
